meta.title: Refactor verifyReplicationTasks
meta.body_summary: Simplify verifyReplicationTasks logic and enable concurrent verification with configurable concurrency for better throughput.

perf_labels.notes: Small concurrent verification refactor with no review activity; PR closed unmerged after long inactivity, possibly due to missing performance evidence and test failure in PR description.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 69 changed lines, this is a tiny refactor. As a concurrency performance PR, it was closed without merge due to total lack of review engagement rather than technical objections.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review was conducted; the PR received only a stale bot comment months after creation and was never merged.
review_details.performance_claim: Enable concurrent verification of replication tasks to increase throughput.
review_details.rejection_signals: No human review activity; PR closed as stale/inactive without any performance or correctness feedback.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Even a small, self-contained Go concurrency refactor can fail to gain traction when maintainers do not engage. Missing benchmarks and a failing test command likely discouraged review.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after metrics; the provided test command fails with a Go toolchain download issue, reducing confidence in the change.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR left open for months with no review; eventually closed without merge.

core_change_summary.description: In activities.go, refactored verifyReplicationTasks to use goroutines with a configurable maxConcurrentVerifications limit, replacing sequential processing. Test file updated to exercise new concurrency behavior; force_replication_workflow.go received a one-line change likely for import.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test file adds concurrency-related test case; force_replication_workflow.go had minimal change.
change_trajectory: Single commit: added configurable concurrent verification in activities.go, updated tests, minor import in workflow file.

review_signals.action_taken: PR remained open until eventually closed.
